name: The Westin Dublin
insider_take: Sleeping in a bank has never felt so luxurious — The Westin Dublin occupies a stunning 19th-century former bank building right in the heart of one of Europe's most vibrant cities.
whats_special: The Westin Dublin is housed in two beautifully restored Victorian landmark buildings on Westmoreland Street, steps from Trinity College and the famous River Liffey. The hotel blends rich Irish heritage with modern luxury, featuring the brand's signature Heavenly Bed® and a spectacular atrium lobby that whispers old-world grandeur. As part of the Marriott Luminous Program , members enjoy elevated perks and rewards throughout their stay.
pro_tip: Request a room overlooking the historic Westmoreland Street for a quintessential Dublin streetscape view — especially magical at dusk when the city lights come alive.
pros: Prime location in Dublin city center near Trinity College and Grafton Street
Signature Westin Heavenly Beds for exceptional sleep comfort
Historic building with elegant modern renovations and sophisticated design
WestinWORKOUT fitness studio and wellness amenities
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury city center hotels
Limited parking availability due to central Dublin location
